caseName: Brooks v. Seaboard Air Line Co.
caseNameFull: Mrs. Eugenia Brooks, Administratrix, etc. v. Seaboard Air Line Company
attorneys: Mr. George Westmoreland for petitioner. Mr. Hollis N. Randolph and Mr. Robert S. Parker for respondent.

opinions.text: Petition for a writ of certiorari to the Court of Appeals of the State of Georgia denied because of failure to submit the petition within the time prescribed by the rule.
